Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units. Source activities and assays. Join activities to assays on assay_id. Join activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1217643'. Filter by activities.standard_relation = '='. Filter by activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL. Filter by activities.standard_relation IS NOT NULL. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
